audits.criteria: Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO validated across all deployed client projects.
Automated Axe-core CI checks, manual keyboard traversal, and screen reader verification (VoiceOver & NVDA).
Pixel-accurate rendering across mobile (<480px), tablet (<768px), and wide desktop screens with no horizontal overflow.
Pure functions, isolated data fixtures, strict separation of concerns, and zero unnecessary runtime dependencies.

Our e-commerce checkout drop-off rate fell by 34% within 3 weeks of deploying Felipe's redesigned frontend. The zero layout shift and instant feedback made a monumental difference.
Delivering an enterprise design system across 30 distributed product teams seemed impossible until Felipe stepped in. His component standards and WCAG AA rigor set a new benchmark for us.
